approved_text: Does there exist a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers 1 ≤ d_0 < d_1 < d_2 < ..., whose set of values has natural density 1, such that the block products d_u · d_{u+1} · ... · d_v (for u ≤ v) are distinct for distinct pairs (u, v)?
draft: Does there exist a strictly increasing sequence of positive integers 1 ≤ d_0 < d_1 < d_2 < ..., whose set of values has natural density 1, such that the block products d_u · d_{u+1} · ... · d_v (for u ≤ v) are distinct for distinct pairs (u, v)?
source_docstrings:
Is there a sequence $1 \le d_1 < d_2 < \dots$ with density 1 such that all products
$\prod_{u \le i \le v} d_i$ are distinct?
source_lean:
theorem erdos_421 : answer(sorry) ↔
    ∃ (d : ℕ → ℕ), StrictMono d ∧ 1 ≤ d 0 ∧ HasDensity (Set.range d) 1 ∧
    {(u, v) : ℕ × ℕ | u ≤ v}.InjOn fun (u, v) => ∏ i ∈ Finset.Icc u v, d i
